tradition.lineage: Stomp pop brings together rhythm-forward indie and alternative-pop bands whose emphatic beats and compact hooks translate readily to live performance. Electric riffs, forceful drums and memorable vocal exchanges connect guitar-pop melody with the energy of alternative rock.

extras.description: Emphatic drum patterns and guitar riffs support melodic leads and answering vocals. Compact duo performances can sound full through amplified rhythm guitar and a forceful kick drum, alongside larger-band and more polished pop arrangements.
